name: Sendou Mishio
source:
She is the mother of the main character and a great international actress.

She is hated by her son as if she were his greatest enemy, because she has left his upbringing to her family of servants and has been working hard.

This time, she sends the heroine, Nana, to the her son.

Her intention to do so and her relationship with Nana and the hero are unknown.
